title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Billing Schedule: Activity Rate on the Closing-Month Platform Fee
content:
The platform fee of the month in which a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service closes carries an activity multiplier set by the payouts the service sent in the month ending on the closing date.

**Clause.** A service that sent no payout in the month ending on the closing date, a month that takes in every payout dated fewer than one whole month before the closing date, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's, has an activity multiplier of 0.25, one that sent fewer than 5 payouts in that month has an activity multiplier of 0.5, and any other service has an activity multiplier of one.

## Rate table

| Payouts sent in the month ending on the closing date | Activity multiplier |
|---|---|
| none | 0.25 |
| 1 to 4 | 0.5 |
| 5 or more | one |

Every payout on the service's ledger counts, whatever its destination or kind of pay.

## The month ending on the closing date (hypothetical dates)

For a closure on the 20th of a month, a payout dated the 21st of the previous month is fewer than one whole month before the closing date and counts; a payout dated the 20th of the previous month is one whole month before it and does not count.

## Points of judgement

- A service with exactly 4 payouts in that month is below 5: multiplier 0.5.
- A service with exactly 5 payouts in that month is not below 5: multiplier one.
- A service whose only payouts are older than that month sent no payout in it: multiplier 0.25.
